$comment: Subsystem status matrix for the website command center. Mirrors docs/planning/CURRENT_STATE.md + docs/features/FEATURES.md (source of truth). Statuses: IMPLEMENTED, PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED, ARCHITECTED (target, not built), PLANNED, PLACEHOLDER. 'where' = where the code lives: core (ships), suite (desktop suite, unshipped until ADR-0017), kjd, target (no code). Refresh when CURRENT_STATE.md changes.
